remarks: Renovations just completed on this fabulous sun filled 2 bdrm unit on the Ave! Brand new kitchen & bath with modern cabinets and Italian tile. Hardwood floors throughout, charming sconces, heat & hot water included! Surrounded by 5 star restaurants & designer shops. Blocks to train and I95 for an easy commute/trip to NYC, and ferry to Island Beach! Just in time for Summer! Laundry around back of the building... municipal lots with app for parking. This one has it all! Stove has been ordered and will be installed prior to moving.
